title: decree plugin frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a plugin, .decree/plugins/<name>.md: any of decree's files, shared as one file: a machine, the files of its scripts folder, cron files, migrations and store seeds. The markdown body below the frontmatter tells a person what the plugin is for; decree keeps it as written. decree installs a plugin into .decree/machines/<name>.yml, .decree/scripts/<name>/ and .decree/cron/<name>/ (its installed copy) before `process`, `daemon`, `check` and `graph` read machines, writes its migrations and store seeds once, and never overwrites an installed copy that was edited in place. `decree check` checks the rest: that every `needs` is in plugins/ (P2), that no plugin changed over an edited copy (P3), the installed machine itself (V1-V21), and the cron files and migrations as messages (M1, M3). Reference: docs/reference/plugins.md.

name.description: The plugin's name: equal to the file's stem, plugins/<name>.md, and the name of what it installs: machines/<name>.yml, scripts/<name>/, cron/<name>/ and store/<name>/ (P1).

needs.description: The other plugins this one relies on: each machine it invokes (`machine`), routes through (`router`, or the machine `router` a `model` state with no `router` uses) or emits to. Each must be in plugins/ (P2); `decree plugin import` refuses a plugin whose needs are missing.

machine.description: The machine, as .decree/machines/<name>.yml holds it, without `name`: the plugin's `name` names it. Installed with `name` first; machine.schema.json describes the rest. Optional: a plugin of scripts only is a library other plugins `needs` and source from .decree/scripts/<name>/.

scripts.description: Every file of .decree/scripts/<name>/, by its path there, to its text. A path is plain and relative: no `..`, `.`, empty parts or leading `/` (P1). An installed file is executable when its text starts with `#!`, and otherwise not. A file in scripts/<name>/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed.

cron.description: Every cron file of .decree/cron/<name>/, by its file name there (`<file>.md`), to its text: a cron file as messages.md describes it, with `cron:` and `machine:`. Part of the installed copy, like scripts: a file in cron/<name>/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed, an edit in place counts as an edit, and the folder goes with the plugin.

examples.weekly.md:
---
cron: 0 9 * * 1
machine: newsletter
---
This week's issue.

migrations.description: Migrations, by file name in .decree/migrations/, to their text. Each is written once: only when no file of that name is there and processed.md does not list it, and never overwritten, since a migration is immutable. When the plugin drops one, or is deleted, a migration it wrote that never started (not edited, not in processed.md, no run) is removed; one that started stays as history.

examples.A01-newsletter-setup.md:
---
machine: newsletter
---
Create the subscriber list.

store.description: Seed data for .decree/store/<name>/, by path there, to its text. Each file is written only when absent and is never overwritten or removed: the store is the project's data.

^x-.description: An extension, for a tool built on decree (existential's `x-exist-services`, say): decree reads none, and keeps them on export, as Compose and OpenAPI keep `x-` keys.
